name: tundra
description: Claude Code plugins from SoftwareOne Platform: the issue-to-PR toolkit of adversarial review, test authoring, PR lifecycle, and the pipeline that chains them

plugins.name: issue-to-pr-pipeline
plugins.description: Issue-to-PR orchestration: resolve-issue chains the review, test, and PR-lifecycle skills into one resumable pipeline gated on plan approval, pausing again wherever a decision is yours; resolve-issue-dashboard is a read-only dashboard that visualises a run; resolve-issue-learnings harvests learnings across runs

plugins.name: disconfirm-first
plugins.description: Adversarial review skills: review-issue-fact (issue), review-plan-risk (design), review-code-risk (implementation)

plugins.name: test-authoring
plugins.description: Test authoring plugin: scan-test-gaps, add/update test workflows, optional setup-test-context profiler; rules are read from the plugin, not copied per-repo

plugins.name: pr-lifecycle
plugins.description: Team-agnostic PR lifecycle skills (Azure DevOps or GitHub): open-pr, resolve-pr-comments
